My dear [Mr Shipley](../persons.html#1315),
I am afraid that such an awful subject would not suit with anything so light as the [Monthly Packet](../others.html#52), and that I had therefore better return it which I will do the next time I send into Winchester, I send you the prospectus of a cheap [missionary magazine](../others.html#94), which [Miss Mackenzie](../persons.html#930) hopes to make very interesting

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge
[In different handwriting on the second half of the sheet]
Dear Mr Bramley
I am very sorry for this Suppose you write to the [Churchman Family](../others.html#63) (Bride’s Avenue, Fleet St, Hogg & Son) by return of post & offer the MS - say it is suitable for Lent & must appear then V.

Orby Shipley

[^1]: The Net Cast in Many Waters: Sketches from the Life of Missionaries, a missionary magazine edited by Anne Mackenzie and published annually from 1866 to 1896.
